stations.title: Draft model
stations.text: Writes a reply to each ticket.
stations.note: Free text. No regex can grade it.

stations.title: Judge model
stations.text: Reads a draft against the rules.
stations.note: Its answer is not always clear.

captions: Replies are scored. Next: Ines wants every reply draft checked against her four rules.
Today someone skims each draft, and one already promised a refund.
You write the code that asks a judge model and reads its answer, in three tasks.
Now the PB-20981 draft gets a verdict, and an unclear answer stays unknown.
Same drafts, a verdict for each, and no guess counted as a pass.
